newsitem.title: USA: Northern shuts Minn. coal units for repair.
newsitem.headline: Northern shuts Minn. coal units for repair.

text.p: Northern States Power Co said it took off line two of its Minnesota coal-fired power units for repairs on Thursday.
The 712 megawatt (MW) Sherburne County unit 1 near Becker, Minn., was shut down Thursday for a valve repair, with no restart date yet set, a company spokeswoman said Thursday.

Also the 176 MW Black Dog unit 4 in Burnsville, Minn. was taken off line September 11 for a tube leak repair, the spokeswoman said. The company had made no estimates as to the timing of restart of the Black Dog unit, she said.
